meaning.p1: Achievements in Corelia reflect what you have truly completed: finished courses, earned certificates, and unlocked technical milestones.
meaning.p2: Certificates and badges are designed to support your learning portfolio, workshops, hackathons, and Web3 journey, rather than acting as formal academic degrees.
